answer: One garden, 240 plots, one window. Each plot locks 65 POA, +25 per extra identity from one root; ten linked fakes lock 1,775 POA. A plot fruits when a raven carries a willow-sealed message to a stranger in a 20-minute window, sealed by a three-epoch gardener. One operator flies two ravens at most, so ten fakes need five hands and ten seals at once. A missed flight burns 20, a failed seal 15. The chain reads the flight graph: flights sharing one hand collapse into one, and a seal without three-epoch history is void. Bonds can be bought; five hands and ten strangers in twenty minutes cannot.
